description: EVERY TURN, ONE CALL. Several agents on one key: pass agent_token. [ev:id] is yours; [ev:id@agent] is another agent. Lost context: context_state=lost. kind=result when done, kind=handoff if you stop midway. Single-call mode (fewest calls): turn(user_message=<new user text>, msg_ref=<id>, recap=[{ref,user,answer=<your PREVIOUS answer exactly as sent>}]) with no draft: saves+seals the previous turn and returns the context for the new message (facts, cubes, self_check) + seal: end your new reply with that seal (one-step lag; your current reply goes in the next call's recap). Classic mode: turn(user_message, draft) before the user sees the reply. Compact mode (compact=true): self-check first, send the final answer once as answer=<final> (draft alias); saved+sealed, not echoed; missed_turns duty -> add recap=[{ref,user,answer}] to your next turn; facts max 3 x 200 chars; cubes/self_check only when changed (else cubes_version/checklist_version). Memory is searched in its base_language (returned as base_language + search_language_rule): when the user writes in another language pass query=<the question in base_language> and search_as in it. The server does not judge your draft: it returns memory facts with [ev:id], relevant cubes and a self_check list - check the draft yourself; if you change it, call turn again (same user_message). Server checks only that every [ev:id] exists in your memory (else verdict=revise + invalid_ids, nothing saved), saves the turn and returns the seal: append it as the last line. No draft = context only. Memory missing or user says remember/вспомни: dig deeper first - memory_search by meaning and by keywords (lines=all, offset for older), memory_event for full text; still nothing -> memory_recall_later(query, search_as=<same statement forms>) deep search (~10-30 s), poll memory_recall_status - only then say you do not remember.

profile_review.description: With l2_summary: JSON {"ops":[...]} or {"no_changes":true,"reason":"<why, >=20 chars>"}; required after the first 3 L2 (else L2 rejected).

query.description: Optional search text instead of user_message: the user's question in the memory base_language (turn/step_zero report base_language).

search_as.description: Optional, recommended when the user asks a question about the past: up to 3 short statements of how the answer was most likely WRITTEN in memory - statement form, not a question; first person as the speaker said it ("my kids loved...", "I went to...") and third person with names; in the memory's base_language (turn/step_zero report it; translate the question if the user wrote in another language; keep names); never invent the unknown fact. Searched together with the question (finds answers a question-shaped query misses, esp. cross-language).

name: turn
